acip: DE LA CHOS KYI SKYE MCHED KYI GZUGS LNGA NI DNGOS POR SMRA BA'I GRUB MTHAS BTAGS PA MIN GYI, MDO LAS GSUNGS SHING RANG NYID KYANG DE LTAR DU BZHED DO,,
english: Now the five types of form relating to the sense door of all things are not something simply imputed by the school of thought known as the Functionalists. Rather, they have been stated in sutra, and we also accept them as being such.
wylie: de la chos kyi skye mched kyi gzugs lnga ni dngos por smra ba'i grub mthas btags pa min gyi, mdo las gsungs shing rang nyid kyang de ltar du bzhed do
